schema:
Node tables:
  Stadium(stadium_id INT64 primary key, location STRING, name STRING, capacity INT64, highest INT64, lowest INT64, average INT64)
  Singer(singer_id INT64 primary key, name STRING, country STRING, song_name STRING, song_release_year STRING, age INT64, is_male BOOLEAN)
  Concert(concert_id INT64 primary key, concert_name STRING, theme STRING, year STRING)
Relationship tables:
  (:Concert)-[:HELD_AT]->(:Stadium)
  (:Singer)-[:PERFORMED_IN]->(:Concert)

examples.q: How many singers do we have?
What are the names of the stadiums without any concerts?
examples.sql: SELECT name FROM stadium WHERE stadium_id NOT IN (SELECT stadium_id FROM concert)
examples.cypher: MATCH (st:Stadium) WHERE NOT EXISTS { MATCH (:Concert)-[:HELD_AT]->(st) } RETURN st.name

examples.q: Show the stadium name and the number of concerts in each stadium.
examples.sql: SELECT T2.name, count(*) FROM concert AS T1 JOIN stadium AS T2 ON T1.stadium_id = T2.stadium_id GROUP BY T1.stadium_id

examples.q: List singer names and number of concerts for each singer.
examples.sql: SELECT T2.name, count(*) FROM singer_in_concert AS T1 JOIN singer AS T2 ON T1.singer_id = T2.singer_id GROUP BY T2.singer_id
